description: The file defines a struct 'HookJob' representing a job with text and timestamp and an actor 'HookExecutor' responsible for executing hooks, managing process execution, environment setup, and timing constraints.

classes.name: HookExecutor
classes.description: An actor responsible for executing hook commands asynchronously with cooldown and timeout handling.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines whether enough time has passed since last execution based on cooldown seconds.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the hook command with provided job data, manages environment variables, process execution, and applies timeout cancellation.
